description: Start a supervised browser session: a hosted Chromium browser your agent drives while a person can watch live, take exclusive control and hand it back. It signs in with the browser profile this API key keeps, so cookies and sign-ins carry over between sessions. Next, call create_viewer_grant to get the person a viewer link. While the person holds control, agent actions are refused; after they hand back, call get_a11y_tree or screenshot before acting again. Later tools use this session unless you pass session_id. viewport_mode defaults to follow-human; use fixed when the page layout must stay at the agent viewport. Charged per minute. Needs a live key (rvp_live_).

egress.description: The network route, fixed for the session. warp routes through a WARP-backed gateway; direct uses the default route. Omitted egress uses the account default (warp); where warp is unconfigured it resolves direct, while explicit warp refuses. Keep warp unless the site blocks WARP or is geo-sensitive, then use direct. Keep one mode per profile: a profile signed in on one mode may log out on the other. Read egress_mode for the actual route.

viewport_mode.description: follow-human (default): the page resizes to the person's viewer while they hold control. fixed: the page keeps the agent viewport.

name: start_supervised_session
title: Start supervised browser session
